description:
## Why

PKIX-baac.8's live-log fixture capture script (`pkix-ct/tests/fixtures/live-log/capture_live_log.py`) had to implement RFC 6962 §3.4 MerkleTreeLeaf construction from scratch in Python, because pkix-ct does not expose a Rust helper that does the same.

pkix-ct's own rustdoc on `SctVerifier::verify_inclusion` says:

> `leaf_hash` is the RFC 6962 §2.1 leaf hash: `SHA256(0x00 || MerkleTreeLeaf-bytes)`. Computing it from an SCT plus the cert it commits to is the caller's responsibility; `pkix-ct` does not currently ship a `MerkleTreeLeaf` builder (that lives one level above SCT signature verification, which is `verify_sct_for_*`).

Any consumer that wants to verify inclusion proofs for SCTs they've already verified must re-implement the §3.4 encoding (x509_entry or precert_entry form), or call into pkix-ct's internal `build_signed_input_*` helpers which are not pub.

## What

Add a public function (probably on `SctVerifier` or as a free function in `pkix_ct`):

```rust
pub fn merkle_tree_leaf_for_cert(sct: &SignedCertificateTimestamp, cert_der: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<u8>>;
pub fn merkle_tree_leaf_for_precert(
    sct: &SignedCertificateTimestamp,
    leaf_cert_der: &[u8],
    issuer_cert_der: &[u8],
) -> Result<Vec<u8>>;
```

These return the MerkleTreeLeaf byte string the caller can SHA-256 (after the 0x00 leaf-domain-separator) to get the inclusion proof's leaf hash. Internally these would share code with `build_signed_input_x509_entry` and `build_signed_input_precert_entry` — the only difference is the outer wrapping (MerkleTreeLeaf wraps a TimestampedEntry; the signed input for SCT signature verification is the same TimestampedEntry preceded by version + signature_type bytes per §3.2).

## Acceptance

- [ ] Public helpers as above.
- [ ] Tests reuse the existing live-log fixture: derive leaf_hash via the new helper, compare to the captured leaf-hash.bin, run verify_inclusion against the captured STH.
- [ ] Capture script in `tests/fixtures/live-log/` updated to cross-check its own Python computation against the Rust helper (run-on-capture only).
- [ ] no_std preserved.

## Out of scope

- Refactoring the existing `build_signed_input_*` functions — keep them private.
- Adding a streaming / no-alloc variant.

## Filed by

PKIX-baac.8 implementation (2026-05-11) noticed the gap while writing capture_live_log.py.
title: pkix-ct: ship a public MerkleTreeLeaf builder helper
